## 2027 Detailed schedule

Lecture: Monday, 8:00–9:45.
Practical: Thursday or Friday, 13:00–14:45.

| Week beginning | Content |
| --- | --- |
| Feb. 22 | U1 Introduction, review, demonstration |
| Mar. 1 | U2 R & RStudio |
| Mar. 8 | U3 Regression part 1 |
| Mar. 15 | U4 Regression part 2 |
| Mar. 22 | U5 Analysis of variance (no Friday practical: Good Friday, 26 March) |
| Mar. 29 | -- Easter break: no lecture, no practicals |
| Apr. 5 | U6 Multiple regression |
| Apr. 12 | U7 Interactions |
| Apr. 19 | U8 Count data (lecture in the morning as usual; Sechseläuten in the afternoon) |
| Apr. 26 | U9 Binary data |
| May 3 | U10 Ordination (no Thursday practical: Ascension, 6 May) |
| May 10 | U11 Mixed models & What next? |
| May 17 | -- No lecture (Whit Monday, 17 May); review / catch-up practicals |
| May 24 | U12 Review |
| May 31 | -- No lecture; review / catch-up practicals |

If your practical day falls on a holiday (Good Friday or Ascension), please come to the practical on the other day that week.
